create_EmbeddingVisualizer: create an EmbeddingVisualizer instance with a system and config to visualize neural field embeddings
run_validation: run the validation method to render and warp-visualize embedding fields from a batch of coordinates
run_validation_image: run the validation_image method to produce image outputs for embedding visualization during validation
run_validation_video: run the validation_video method to produce video outputs for embedding visualization during validation
review_EmbeddingVisualizer: review the EmbeddingVisualizer class and its validation methods for embedding field visualization
